name: poker_pal_api
description: PokerPal backend: Cloud Functions (REST API) + Firestore rules

scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions

//firebase-sdk-pins: firebase-functions is held at v6 because v7 requires firebase-tools >= 15, while the installed CLI (14.3.1) still injects runtime config through the functions.config() API that v7 removed, which kills the function on load in the emulator. firebase-admin follows at v13 to satisfy functions v6's peer range. Only onRequest (v2), the logger, getAuth and getFirestore are used here, and all four are identical across these versions.
